pages.title: Pricing pages
pages.description: Public pricing or product pages to read. Add a name to an entry to label the competitor, for example {"url": "https://sat.magoosh.com/plans", "name": "Magoosh"}. Without a name the site name is used.

delayBetweenPagesMs.title: Delay between pages (ms)
delayBetweenPagesMs.description: Pause after each page, so a site is not hit in quick succession.

concurrency.title: Pages read at the same time
concurrency.description: 1 to 4. Pages are read one after another per worker.

historyStoreName.title: History store name
historyStoreName.description: Named key-value store that remembers the prices of the last successful read of each page, so the next run can show the change. Use another name for a separate watch list.

updateHistory.title: Save this run as the new baseline
updateHistory.description: Turn off for a test run that should not replace the saved prices.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Leave empty to read pages directly. A proxy is only for reaching a page from another country; it is not used to get past a bot check.
